key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:222E
name: enable_dma_and_interrupts
description: Copies two coordinate words from one state block into another and disables all interrupt and DMA bits through the custom chip enable words. It then sets new enable masks after nine subroutine calls and stores a pointer and a cleared flag in the state block.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:22B0
name: setup_copper_and_dma_registers
description: Disables all interrupt sources, loads a copper list pointer pair from a state block into the copper pointer registers, and sets the DMA control word. It then enables selected DMA and interrupt bits from stored values, with subroutine calls between the steps.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2338
name: wait_for_vertical_blank
description: Polls the interrupt request word until its vertical blank bit is set, then writes that bit back to the interrupt request register to acknowledge it. It returns the bit value that ended the wait.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:234A
name: wait_for_vertical_blank_frames
description: Waits for the vertical blank bit once per frame in the requested count, acknowledging each one through the interrupt request register. The count is passed in the data register.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2362
name: wait_for_flag_repeatedly
description: Repeatedly clears a flag byte in a state block and spins until a handler sets it non-zero. The number of repetitions is the input value multiplied by a word from a state block.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:237A
name: forward_call_to_subroutine
description: Calls one other subroutine and returns without doing any work of its own. It is a thin wrapper.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2388
name: build_copper_list_entries
description: Fills a copper list with move and wait instructions. It writes bitplane pointer pairs from three source addresses, colour register entries from a table, sprite pointer entries and an end marker, then saves the list position pointers into the state block.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2634
name: copy_table_into_buffers
description: Copies seventeen long words from a table in a base block into a buffer, then copies seventeen words from a later point in the same table into a second area of the buffer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2666
name: get_state_field_pointer
description: Returns the address of one fixed field inside the shared state block. The field is located at a constant offset from the block pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2676
name: store_word_in_state
description: Stores the word passed in the data register into a fixed word field of the shared state block.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2680
name: initialize_copper_list_slots
description: Sets a state flag from the subroutine result. It then fills either thirteen or six copper list entries with fixed filler words, clearing the flag in the first case and setting it in the second.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:26C4
name: store_state_and_copy_table
description: Stores the subroutine result as a counter and sets a companion word to minus one. It then copies six words from a global table into alternating positions of a buffer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:26EE
name: update_sprite_motion_frame
description: Toggles a frame bit and increments a frame counter, then applies pending table data to a copper list. Otherwise it moves an object by a velocity scaled by a subroutine value, clamps the position to limits and calls subroutines to record it.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:272C
name: dispatch_through_unrecovered_pointer
description: Jumps through a pointer whose target was not recovered, so it only forwards control to code that is not present here. It contains no other logic.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2730
name: acknowledge_selected_interrupt_requests
description: Reads the interrupt request word, keeps only the copper, vertical blank and blitter bits, and writes them back to clear those requests. It then sets a state flag to one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2748
name: acknowledge_ports_interrupt
description: Calls one subroutine, then writes the ports interrupt bit to the interrupt request register to acknowledge it. The incoming register values are passed back to the caller unchanged.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:275C
name: jump_through_unrecovered_pointer
description: Forwards execution through a jump pointer that was not recovered, so its behaviour depends on code missing from this dump. It has no other logic.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2760
name: cycle_copper_pattern_timer
description: Counts down a timer while enabled and toggles a phase word each time it expires. It then fills six list entries with a fixed value and resets the timer, or copies six words from a table and sets a longer timer, before forwarding to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2790
name: reload_copper_table_timer
description: Sets the frame timer to a fixed value, copies six words from a global table into the copper list, and forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:27BA
name: flush_pending_copper_entries
description: Copies eleven words of pending data into the copper list when a flag is set, and fills six entries from a table when a stored index is non-negative. It clears the index afterwards and forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2820
name: initialize_player_input_state
description: Resets the input-state fields of a state block and sets a timer to a tenth of a global byte value. It calls two subroutines and stores the values they return in the block.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2878
name: feed_table_word_into_copper
description: Every third frame, when a flag is set, takes the next word from a cursor in a table and writes it to a fixed copper list slot. The cursor restarts at the table start when the word is zero, and control then forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:28EE
name: store_result_and_forward
description: Stores a subroutine result and a second returned value into the state block, calls one more subroutine, and forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2902
name: check_regions_on_state_change
description: Compares two stored state bytes with newly read values. When one changes to a non-zero value, it scans a list of rectangular regions for one that contains the current position and matches its flag bit, then stores the new values and forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2922
name: scan_regions_for_position_flags
description: Scans a list of rectangular regions for one with the first flag bit set that contains the current position. It then checks a second stored byte and updates the state block before forwarding to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:295A
name: update_second_state_flag
description: Compares a stored state byte with a newly read value and, when it changed to non-zero, scans the region list for a match on the high flag bit. It then stores the new values and forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:296A
name: apply_second_state_change
description: Stores a newly read state byte and a second returned value, then checks a region list for a match on the high flag bit when the new byte is non-zero. It forwards to an unrecovered jump target afterwards.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:298E
name: scan_regions_for_second_flag
description: Walks a list of rectangular regions until it finds one with the high flag bit that contains the current position. It calls a subroutine on a match and otherwise performs the common state update before forwarding to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:29C6
name: store_state_and_tick_counter
description: Stores a subroutine result and a second returned value into the state block, calls one more subroutine, and decrements a non-zero counter in the block. It then forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:29D6
name: store_state_and_run_tail
description: Runs an extra subroutine call before storing a result and a second value into the state block, then decrements a non-zero counter. It forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2A1C
name: decode_keyboard_serial_byte
description: Handles the keyboard serial register handshake by clearing the previous acknowledge and reading a byte when the strobe bits are set. It splits the byte into a key state bit and a key code, updates a held-key bitmap for codes in a narrow range, and returns the decoded code or minus one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2A7A
name: set_key_bitmap_bit
description: Sets one bit in a held-key bitmap in the state block, using the low three bits of the input to select it. It returns minus one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2A82
name: read_key_bitmap_byte
description: Returns one byte of the held-key bitmap from the state block.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2A8E
name: clear_buffer_and_reset_counters
description: Resets several counters and flags in a state block and sets one byte through a pointer to a fixed value. It then clears a buffer of 336 words.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2AC0
name: scroll_bitplane_buffer_frame
description: Advances a wrapping offset by two bytes out of forty-two and copies byte pairs for eight bit planes from two source addresses into a ring buffer at that offset. It also updates the copper pointers and copies seven words from a table row into the copper list when a flag is set.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2AE6
name: advance_scroll_buffer_countdown
description: Decrements a countdown held at the address passed in a register when a flag is set. On expiry it resets the countdown, copies byte pairs into the ring buffer, advances the offset, and forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2BC6
name: advance_copper_table_cursor
description: Moves a table cursor forward by one row unless it has reached its limit. It then copies seven words from that table row into the copper list and forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2BF6
name: call_and_return_first_word
description: Calls one subroutine, calls a second one, and returns the word produced by the first call.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2C16
name: read_next_text_character
description: Reads the next byte from a circular text buffer, moving backwards with wrap-around at eighty entries. It returns the character's offset from the space character in units of eight, or zero with a cleared active flag when the buffer is empty.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2C3E
name: clear_text_active_flag
description: Clears a flag in the state block and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2C46
name: scan_string_for_nonzero_result
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string, calling a subroutine on each character and setting an active flag. It stops when the subroutine returns a non-zero value and returns that value, or zero when the string ends first.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2C68
name: write_byte_to_text_ring
description: Stores one byte at the write index of a circular text buffer and then advances the index with wrap-around. It returns one without advancing when the buffer is full and zero otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2C8C
name: set_text_write_index
description: Sets the write index of a circular text buffer to the value passed in a register and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2D2E
name: decrement_timer_array
description: Decrements each non-zero counter in a block of nine words by one. It then forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2D44
name: initialize_motion_and_bounds
description: Sets velocity, position and clamping bounds in a state block and stores two bytes read from the argument structure. It clears the history counters, calls one subroutine and fills a four-entry position history.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2DCC
name: step_position_within_bounds
description: Either clears two blocks of object data or advances the position by velocity or by a scaled step with fractional accumulators. The new position is clamped to the stored x and y bounds, then two subroutines are called and control forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2E40
name: clamp_position_to_bounds
description: Clamps the x and y values passed in registers to the stored bounds and saves them as the current position. It then calls two subroutines and forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2E56
name: clamp_y_and_store_position
description: Clamps the vertical value passed in a register to its stored bound, saves it with the horizontal value as the current position, calls two subroutines, and forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2E74
name: offset_and_clamp_position
description: Adds the stored offset to the current position and clamps the result to the stored bounds. It saves the clamped position, calls two subroutines, and forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2E86
name: clear_object_data_pointers
description: Clears two blocks of object data through pointers held in the state block and forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2EA6
name: compute_wrapped_byte_deltas
description: Stores two newly read bytes as the previous values and returns the signed differences from the old values. Each difference is wrapped into the signed byte range.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2EE6
name: compute_direction_and_delta
description: Returns two values: the complement of the first input, negated when a flag is set, and the second input minus a stored value, wrapped into the signed byte range.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2F0E
name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2F24
name: record_position_history_entry
description: Stores the current position in a four-entry history ring, steps the ring index back with wrap-around, and writes a subroutine value or zeros into two output slots. The slots are a fixed distance apart in the buffer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2F7A
name: advance_history_index_and_write
description: Steps a four-entry index with wrap-around, reads a value from a subroutine, and writes it into four slots of a buffer at fixed offsets. It writes zeros instead when a flag is clear.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:2FF2
name: pack_coordinates_with_flags
description: Adds two offsets to the stored position and packs the sums into a single long word. Overflow bits of the sums and the low bit of the horizontal value are set as flag bits, and a fixed flag bit is always set.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:303E
name: read_fire_button_pressed
description: Returns minus one when a bit of the cached port A status byte is clear, which means the fire button is pressed, and zero otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3052
name: read_mouse_counters_and_store
description: Temporarily disables the master interrupt enable while it reads the mouse counter word into two state bytes. It re-enables interrupts afterwards if they were enabled before, and stores two input flags.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:308C
name: store_position_with_interrupts_masked
description: Temporarily disables the master interrupt enable, stores two input words as the current position, and re-enables interrupts if they were enabled before.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:30BA
name: store_velocity_components
description: Stores two input words into the velocity fields of a state block.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3200
name: pop_queued_entry_or_marker
description: Produces a result record according to the queue state: a fixed code when queueing is disabled, a different fixed code when nothing is pending, the next queued entry's words when one is popped, or a code with the current position otherwise. It takes entries from a ring of pointers and clears them after use.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:32C8
name: clear_queue_entries
description: Resets the queue head, tail and count words and zeroes 128 two-long entries of a buffer. It also restores the master interrupt enable if it was set.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:330C
name: enable_queue_processing
description: Sets a state word to one, which enables queue processing.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3318
name: disable_queue_processing
description: Sets a state word to zero, which disables queue processing.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3322
name: store_mask_and_test_bit
description: Stores the input word, masked to a fixed set of bits, as a control word. It sets a counter to minus one when the low bit of the input is clear and returns that low bit.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:336A
name: enqueue_entry_with_position
description: When the input bits match the stored control word and the queue is not full, it appends an entry to the end of a list. It saves the entry pointer in a ring of pointers and writes the two input words followed by the current position.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3390
name: append_position_record_at_pointer
description: Records a buffer pointer in the ring of queued entries and advances the ring head. It then writes two input words followed by the current position into the buffer at the address passed in an address register.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:33C0
name: scale_value_to_counter
description: Multiplies the input by a stored word and divides by sixty. It stores the result as a byte counter with a minimum of one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:33E2
name: copy_region_list_with_offsets
description: Copies a linked list of rectangle entries into the state block, keeping each entry's left and top edges. It stores the right and bottom edges as the far edges derived from the entry size and ends the copy with a negative marker.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:342A
name: render_text_string_with_blitter
description: Draws a text string into two bitplane buffers by copying each character's glyph from two font tables. It then programs the blitter with masks and channel controls and starts it five times, waiting for the blitter to be free before each start.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3524
name: skip_no_operation
description: Does nothing and returns, so callers that reach it simply continue.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:352E
name: initialize_render_buffer_state
description: Sets two buffer pointers in the state block to their alternate positions and clears the flags and counters. It also sets the blitter priority bit in the DMA control word and resets the copper slot fields.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3572
name: swap_buffers_and_wait_sync
description: Copies six long words from the current buffer into a staging area and requests an update. It then swaps the two buffer pointers and waits until the update flag is cleared.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3886
name: call_two_subroutines
description: Calls two other subroutines in order and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:38A4
name: compute_global_offset_and_call
description: Calls one subroutine, stores a global address computed from the low word of a register as a scaled offset, and then calls another subroutine.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:38CA
name: process_entries_until_negative
description: Walks a list of five-word entries, calling a subroutine for each one, until it reaches an entry whose first word is negative.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:38E0
name: blit_sprite_rows_with_masks
description: Sets up blitter masks and widths for a sprite from a five-row descriptor and runs one blit per row, waiting for the blitter to finish each. When the horizontal position is not aligned to a 16-bit boundary, it adds an edge pass with a shifted first-word mask.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:39F6
name: store_parameters_and_call
description: Stores three input values into global variables and then calls two subroutines.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3A54
name: call_two_routines_then_stop
description: Calls two subroutines in order. The code after those calls decodes as invalid data, so no further behaviour is recovered from this routine.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3A6E
name: blit_list_entry_and_dispatch
description: Stores a pointer argument and an advanced copy of it for later use, then computes blitter width and offsets from the referenced record. It programs five row blits from two buffer tables and finishes by calling a routine through a stored pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3AFE
name: blit_sprite_entry_by_mode
description: Stores two input words into a sprite record. When the first flag bit is set it runs the clipping logic and blits the visible rows, otherwise it blits five rows of a fixed-size sprite directly.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3BBE
name: clip_and_blit_sprite_rows
description: Clips a sprite's horizontal and vertical extent against fixed screen bounds and stores the clipped masks and offsets in globals. It then blits the visible rows, waiting for the blitter to finish each one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3F36
name: step_sixteen_flagged_writes
description: Runs sixteen steps, each waiting for two flag bytes to be set by an external handler and calling a subroutine. Each step writes a computed byte into a table at the stored pointer, with the value depending on the step index and the input flag.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:3FD6
name: decay_packed_nibble_fields
description: Walks a table of four-byte entries and reduces each packed field of the second word by one unit, leaving fields at zero unchanged. The three fields are the high, middle and low nibbles.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4010
name: step_nibbles_toward_targets
description: Walks a table of four-byte entries and moves each packed nibble field of the second word one step toward the matching field of a second table. It advances to the next entry each time.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4062
name: clear_five_buffers
description: Zeroes five buffers of two thousand long words each, whose addresses are listed in the state block.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4084
name: service_four_audio_channels
description: Applies a pending command to each of four audio channels. A load command sets the sample pointer, length and period and enables the channel's DMA bit, a stop command disables that bit, and an idle channel gets a default length and sample address. It then forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:40B6
name: service_audio_channels_loop
description: Services audio channels from the highest index down. It loads sample pointers and enables DMA for queued load commands, disables DMA for stop commands, and forwards to an unrecovered jump target when finished.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:40FA
name: service_audio_channels_default
description: Writes a default length and sample address for the current channel, then walks the channels downward. It disables DMA for stop commands and loads sample pointers for queued commands, then forwards to an unrecovered jump target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4134
name: set_channel_pending_command
description: Sets a channel's pending command to a stop type and stores a word from the first argument. It also stores a pointer computed from the low word of the second argument, scaled by eight, in the channel table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:41AE
name: call_with_base_pointer_offset
description: Calls a subroutine with an address computed from a base register and a fixed offset, passing the input value through, and returns its result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:41D4
name: copy_byte_block
description: Copies a block of bytes from the source address to the destination address, counting down a 32-bit length. It returns the destination address and makes no library calls of its own.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4264
name: return_immediately
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:426C
name: start_program_and_parse_startup
description: Allocates a context block and tags it with a four-character marker, then finds the calling task. When started from the command line it parses the arguments, otherwise it reads the startup message and opens its input and output through DOS, then calls the main routine and replies with its result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:43FE
name: split_command_line_into_args
description: Allocates an argument buffer and copies the command line into it, splitting on spaces and tabs while honouring double-quoted arguments. It builds a null-terminated list of pointers to the arguments and does nothing if the allocation fails.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4400
name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Copies the command line into a newly allocated buffer, splitting it into arguments on whitespace and keeping quoted text together. It returns a null-terminated pointer list, and returns early when the allocation fails.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:45BC
name: append_bounded_string
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most the given number of characters. It always terminates the result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:45BE
name: concatenate_limited_text
description: Appends at most a given number of characters from one string to the end of another and terminates the result. It repeats the behaviour of the nearby string append routine.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:45E2
name: load_icon_tooltype_list
description: Opens the icon library and reads the tool types of an icon, including the window entry, into an array. It stores the count and the array pointer in the given block and closes the library afterwards.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:46CC
name: append_string_to_end
description: Appends a zero-terminated source string to the end of a destination string and returns the destination address.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:46CE
name: concatenate_strings_unbounded
description: Appends a zero-terminated source string to the end of a destination string and returns the destination address. It repeats the behaviour of the earlier append routine.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:46E2
name: copy_string_with_padding
description: Copies at most a given number of characters from the source string to the destination. Once the source ends it fills any remaining count with zero bytes, and it returns the destination address.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4712
name: create_named_message_port
description: Allocates a signal bit and a port structure, then fills in its name, type and signal fields and records the owning task. It initialises the message list for an unnamed port, or adds a named port to the public list, and releases the signal if the allocation fails.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:47B4
name: delete_message_port
description: Removes a named port from the public list and marks the port structure as freed. It then releases its signal bit and frees its memory.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4806
name: format_text_into_buffer
description: Formats text from a template into an output buffer, handling flag characters, width and precision fields and length modifiers. It converts characters, strings and numbers in several bases, stores the count for the count conversion, and returns the number of characters written or minus one on error.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4CFE
name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the characters before the zero terminator of a string and returns the count.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4D10
name: initialize_empty_list_head
description: Sets up a list header so that it points to itself with an empty list.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4D22
name: initialize_each_unit_record
description: Walks a table of twenty-two-byte unit records between two offsets from a base register, calling a subroutine on each record.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4D48
name: write_byte_to_stream
description: Writes one byte to a buffered stream, flushing the buffer when it fills or a newline is written, and returns the byte. It returns minus one when the stream is closed or in an error state.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4EC8
name: close_stream_and_release
description: Flushes and closes a buffered stream, releases its buffer if one was allocated, and clears its fields. It returns zero on success and minus one if any step failed.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4EEA
name: finish_stream_close_status
description: Flushes and closes a buffered stream as the routine above does, but also combines a previously computed status value to decide success. It returns zero when both checks pass and minus one otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4F8C
name: return_success_zero
description: Returns zero without doing anything else.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4F92
name: flush_all_open_streams
description: Flushes every open stream in the stream table when given a null pointer, or flushes only the stream passed in. It returns minus one if a flush fails and zero otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4F96
name: flush_streams_or_one
description: Behaves like the stream flush routine above, flushing all open streams for a null pointer and otherwise only the one stream given. It returns minus one on the first failed flush.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4FD4
name: flush_remaining_open_streams
description: Walks the stream table from a given position, flushing each open stream in turn. It stops and returns minus one at the first failure, and returns zero when the table ends.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:4FE6
name: call_single_subroutine
description: Calls one subroutine and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:500E
name: return_without_effect
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:501C
name: negate_result_if_negative
description: Calls one subroutine and returns its second result, negated when the first input is negative. The second input is returned unchanged alongside it.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:5036
name: call_and_pass_through_pair
description: Calls one subroutine and returns the second input passed through together with the subroutine's second result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:5042
name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one subroutine and returns its result unchanged.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:504C
name: divide_long_by_word
description: Divides a 32-bit unsigned value by a divisor, using a bit-by-bit loop when the divisor is wider than sixteen bits and a direct division otherwise. It returns the quotient and remainder as a pair.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:509C
name: initialize_stream_buffer
description: Sets up a stream record with a buffer, allocating a one-kilobyte buffer for ordinary streams. The standard stream instead uses a one-byte buffer stored inside the record, and the buffer pointers and flag bits are set to match.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:5112
name: remove_node_and_free
description: Searches a linked list of allocated nodes for the given node, unlinks it when found and frees its memory. It returns the free result, or zero when the node is not in the list.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:5122
name: find_and_free_list_node
description: Searches the allocation list starting at the given node for the node passed in a register, then unlinks and frees it. It returns zero when the node is not found.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:5138
name: unlink_node_at_position
description: Unlinks the node held in an address register from the allocation list and frees it through the memory release call.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:5140
name: pop_head_and_free
description: Advances the allocation list head to the next node and frees the old head node.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:515A
name: free_all_allocated_nodes
description: Frees every node in the allocation list, then clears the list head and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:5164
name: free_node_chain_and_clear
description: Frees each node in a chain starting at the given node, then clears the list head and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:518A
name: allocate_linked_memory_node
description: Allocates a block of the requested size with a link word in front, pushes it onto the allocation list, and returns the usable area after the header. It returns zero for a zero size or a failed allocation.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:51D4
name: copy_zero_terminated_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated source string into the destination, including the terminator, and returns the destination address.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:51E2
name: check_stream_is_interactive
description: Checks that a stream index is valid and open, then asks DOS whether that stream is interactive. It returns one or zero, or minus one with an error code set when the index is invalid.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:5244
name: seek_stream_position
description: Checks a stream index and seeks the stream to the given position through DOS. If the seek fails it stores the DOS error code and returns minus one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:52D4
name: delete_file_by_name
description: Deletes a file through DOS. When the deletion fails it records the DOS error code and returns minus one, otherwise it returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:5306
name: return_zero_status
description: Returns zero without doing anything else.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:530A
name: write_block_to_stream
description: Checks a stream index and access mode, optionally repositions the stream before writing, then writes a block of data through DOS. It stores the DOS error code and returns minus one on failure.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:53B8
name: check_break_signal_bits
description: Reads the task signal bits from the system library. It returns zero when the break bit is clear, returns the bits when the break bit is set and a stored flag is zero, and otherwise calls a handler and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:53EE
name: write_global_word_to_output
description: Writes a four-byte global value to the standard output through DOS, then calls one other subroutine with the value one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:5428
name: run_pending_exit_routines
description: Runs each pending exit routine from a linked list, unlinking nodes as it goes. It then runs a final hook if one is set and calls one more subroutine.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:545A
name: shut_down_program_resources
description: Closes every open stream, releases the allocated buffers and locks, restores saved values, and closes the libraries it opened. It then frees the program's own memory and returns the given value.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:55B4
name: skip_empty_routine
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfp:0:55BA
name: close_stream_by_index
description: Checks a stream index, closes the DOS handle unless it is marked as a standard stream, and clears the slot. It returns zero on success and minus one for an invalid index.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0000
name: start_and_open_libraries
description: Program entry point. It opens the DOS, graphics and intuition libraries, saves several values from the startup block, and writes the DMA control word to enable a set of channels. It then runs a sequence of setup calls and ends in a loop waiting on a flag.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:02E2
name: check_fire_button_pressed
description: Returns true when a bit of the cached port A status byte is clear, which means the fire button is pressed, and false otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:02F2
name: check_hardware_status_bit
description: Returns true when one bit of a hardware status byte at a fixed chip address is clear, and false otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0306
name: wait_on_second_flag
description: Returns at once when a first flag is clear. Otherwise it spins until a second flag is set.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0314
name: update_scaled_entry_values
description: Repeats 105 times. Each pass waits for a frame, decrements four per-entry counters toward zero, and writes each scaled value to a destination word with interrupts disabled. The scaled value is a stored byte times its counter, shifted right by eight.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:037C
name: open_named_file
description: Opens a file through DOS using the file name held in the program and stores the handle in the block. It returns true when the open failed.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:03B6
name: copy_second_region_to_start
description: Copies forty-eight thousand bytes from a region that starts forty-eight thousand bytes into a buffer to the start of that same buffer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:03D4
name: clear_bitmap_and_copy_region
description: Clears a bitmap through the graphics library, then copies eight thousand long words from a later point in the buffer to its start.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0400
name: read_entries_until_flag
description: Calls the DOS read routine once for each entry in a table of values. It stops at the first zero entry or when a stored flag is set.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0448
name: read_entries_until_flag
description: Calls the DOS read routine once for each entry in a table of values. It stops at the first zero entry or when a stored flag is set, as the routine above does.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0498
name: read_entries_until_flag
description: Calls the DOS read routine once for each entry in a table of values. It stops at the first zero entry or when a stored flag is set, as the routines above do.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:04D8
name: read_block_from_file
description: Calls the DOS read routine once through the handle stored in the block.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:04FE
name: load_palette_over_frames
description: Sixteen times, it waits for frame events, calls one subroutine and loads the palette through the graphics library. It then clears a state word.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:053A
name: decay_nibble_table_entries
description: Decrements each packed nibble field of a table of words by one unit, keeping zero fields at zero. It does the same as the earlier decay routine but on single words.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0572
name: load_palette_and_set_flag
description: Sixteen times, it waits for frame events, calls one subroutine and loads the palette through the graphics library. It then sets a state word to one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:05B8
name: step_nibble_table_toward_target
description: Moves each packed nibble field of a table of words one step toward the matching field of a second table. It does the same as the earlier stepping routine but on single words.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0608
name: blit_six_row_passes
description: Takes ownership of the blitter, then runs sixteen passes that program the blitter registers for a block of six rows each. It waits for each blit to finish before the next and releases the blitter at the end.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:071A
name: select_audio_channel_mask
description: Sets a global value to a one-bit mask for the given channel number, but only for channel numbers below four. Other inputs leave the value unchanged.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0738
name: call_routine_sixteen_times
description: Calls one subroutine sixteen times and then clears a global value.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:074E
name: start_audio_channel_sample
description: Starts playback on an audio channel when its sample table entry is present. For the first four channels it sets the channel's DMA bit and resets the channel state, then calls a subroutine for the period and stores the sample pointer and length in the channel record.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:07AA
name: store_channel_sample_fields
description: Writes a sample address and a length into an audio channel record, using a fixed value when the length argument is zero. It also updates the channel's pointer and count fields from the arguments.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:07E8
name: set_channel_length_and_pointer
description: Stores a length in an audio record, using a default when the length argument is zero, and updates the channel's pointer and count fields. It also writes a second value into the record.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:07F2
name: update_channel_pointer_fields
description: Stores a length, a pointer offset derived from a count, and a second value into the channel record, updating the channel's count fields.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0834
name: spin_forever_loop
description: Loops indefinitely without an exit and never returns to its caller.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:084E
name: latch_channel_pointer_if_set
description: When the low bit of the input is set and a channel's stored pointer is non-zero, copies that pointer and a related word into the channel record. It returns the input shifted right by one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:086A
name: process_channel_updates
description: When the update flag is set, calls four subroutines and then reads a channel entry. If the entry's low bit is set and its pointer is non-zero, it copies the pointer and a related word into the channel record, and it returns the entry shifted right by one or zero when the flag is clear.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0AD2
name: advance_pattern_playback_tick
description: Advances the playback tick for a pattern sequence: it steps the tick counter, reads each channel's pattern bytes, and applies note, volume and effect commands. It returns a pointer to the next pattern position, or null when playback ends.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0B1C
name: decode_pattern_row_for_channels
description: Decodes one row of pattern data for each of four channels, updating each channel's sample, volume and effect fields and applying the effect commands. It returns a pointer to the next row, or null when the sequence ends.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0BF6
name: continue_pattern_row_decode
description: Handles the remaining per-channel pattern commands, including end-of-pattern and jump commands, and advances the position in the sequence table. It returns a pointer to the next position, or null at the end of the sequence.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0C04
name: continue_pattern_decode_entry
description: Handles the remaining per-channel pattern commands after the row setup and updates the sequence position. It returns a pointer to the next position, or null at the end of the sequence.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0C22
name: decode_pattern_effect_commands
description: Continues the per-channel pattern decode and applies the remaining effect codes, including the repeat, end-of-row and stop commands. It advances the channel position and returns a pointer to the next position, or null when the sequence ends.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0C4E
name: decode_pattern_channel_loop
description: Loops over the channels of a pattern row, decoding each channel's note bytes and applying effect commands such as sample pointer, end-of-pattern and stop codes. It returns a pointer to the next position, or null at the end of the sequence.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0C60
name: advance_pattern_channel_counter
description: Handles the remaining per-channel pattern codes for one row, advancing a row counter on the zero code and applying volume and effect codes. It returns a pointer to the next position, or null when the sequence ends.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0C6A
name: apply_channel_effect_code
description: Applies one effect code from a pattern row to the current channel, setting its volume, speed, offset, sequence jump or slide fields. It then continues the channel loop and returns a pointer to the next position, or null at the end of the sequence.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0C78
name: apply_channel_volume_and_tempo
description: Sets a channel's volume, tempo, panning and sequence jump fields from effect codes in a pattern row, scaling volume to a maximum of sixty-four. It then continues the channel loop and returns a pointer to the next position, or null at the end of the sequence.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0CAA
name: apply_pattern_effect_fields
description: Applies the tempo, panning, sequence jump, slide and volume effects of a pattern row to the channel record. It then continues the row loop and returns a pointer to the next position, or null at the end of the sequence.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0CBE
name: apply_pattern_row_effects
description: Applies the panning, sequence jump, slide, end-of-row and volume effects of a pattern row to the channel record. It then continues the row loop and returns a pointer to the next position, or null at the end of the sequence.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0CD6
name: apply_pattern_jump_and_volume
description: Applies the sequence jump, tempo, panning, slide and volume effects of a pattern row to the channel record. It then continues the row loop and returns a pointer to the next position, or null at the end of the sequence.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0CF6
name: apply_pattern_slide_effect
description: Sets a channel's slide target from a pattern effect code and its offset, and updates the channel's effect fields. It then continues the row loop and returns a pointer to the next position, or null at the end of the sequence.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0D06
name: apply_channel_slide_target
description: Sets a channel's slide target from a period table when the channel index is below four. It then continues the pattern row loop, applying the remaining effect codes, and returns a pointer to the next position or null at the end of the sequence.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:0DF6
name: process_channel_effect_tick
description: Runs the per-tick effect step for one channel, applying slide, period offset and volume changes. It sets the channel's DMA enable bit when a trigger flag is set and returns the result pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:1050
name: dispatch_channel_effect_handler
description: Loops over the channels, decrementing a tick counter and reading each channel's effect code. It sets the DMA enable bit for a channel whose trigger flag is set, then calls an effect handler selected through a table indexed by the effect code.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:1064
name: compute_period_from_note
description: Converts an input value into a period: values below eleven index a fixed table, while larger values divide a stored constant by the input. The low and high bytes of the result are stored through two pointers.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:1068
name: compute_period_from_note
description: Converts an input value into a period in the same way as the routine above, storing the low and high bytes of the result through two pointers.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:106C
name: compute_period_from_note
description: Converts an input value into a period in the same way as the routines above, storing the low and high bytes of the result through two pointers.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:10AC
name: store_buffer_and_return_pointer
description: Stores the address of a global buffer in a channel record. It returns the word at the input pointer together with that pointer advanced by six.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:10CC
name: add_offset_to_nonzero_long
description: Adds the value in the data register to a long word at the address passed in an address register, but only when that long word is non-zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:10D6
name: relocate_section_entries
description: For each loaded section flagged as needing relocation, adds its base address to each long word in its relocation table. It then returns the result of a stored subroutine, or zero when none is set.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:114A
name: load_sample_bytes_and_scale
description: Scales sixteen per-channel values by a stored volume and writes them into a table. It then copies a sample's bytes into a sixty-four byte buffer, interleaving them with a stride, or clears sixty-three words when no sample is present.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:11B6
name: start_module_playback_if_ready
description: Returns a fixed failure code when an initial status value is non-zero. Otherwise it copies a settings byte from the module header into a global, sets flag bits and starts playback, and it refers to the module signature text.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:11DE
name: call_flagged_then_finish
description: When a global flag is set it calls one subroutine, then always calls a second subroutine and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:1258
name: clear_flag_bit_if_active
description: When a global flag is set, clears the low bit of a byte through a pointer and calls one subroutine, returning its result. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:1272
name: open_cia_resource_and_map
description: Opens the CIA resource through the system and sets register addresses for the timer and port hardware, depending on which CIA chip responds. It records the variant found and returns one when a second probe succeeds, otherwise zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdfq:0:1314
name: clear_flag_and_call_library
description: When a flag is set, clears it and calls one routine through the library table. It returns the flag value that was set before.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:bcdft:0:0000
name: run_callback_and_free_block
description: Calls a stored routine through a pointer, waits briefly in a delay loop, frees a memory block through the exec library, and clears the pointer slot it used.

key: ishar 2 - messengers of doom (1993)(silmarils)(m3)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Ishar 2 - Messengers of Doom (1993)(Silmarils)(M3)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:l/Disk-Validator:0:0000
name: xor_decode_block_in_place
description: Repeatedly XORs one thousand seven hundred twenty-nine bytes in place with a key byte that starts at a fixed value and decreases by two at each step. The code after this loop decodes as invalid data, so no further behaviour is recovered.

key: ishar 2 - messengers of doom (1993)(silmarils)(m3)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Ishar 2 - Messengers of Doom (1993)(Silmarils)(M3)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:loading:0:0000
name: load_amigados_executable_hunks
description: Loads an AmigaDOS executable by reading its hunk headers, allocating memory for each code, data and BSS section, and copying section data. It applies relocation entries and stops at the end-of-file hunk, then clears a cache flag and returns.

key: ishar 2 - messengers of doom (1993)(silmarils)(m3)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Ishar 2 - Messengers of Doom (1993)(Silmarils)(M3)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:loading:0:017C
name: delay_loop_countdown
description: Counts a 16-bit value down to zero in a tight loop, which serves as a short delay.

key: ishar 2 - messengers of doom (1993)(silmarils)(m3)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Ishar 2 - Messengers of Doom (1993)(Silmarils)(M3)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:loading:0:01CC
name: unpack_compressed_data_backward
description: Decodes a compressed byte stream into a buffer by writing from the end toward the start. It copies literal runs and repeated back-references, stops when the output reaches the start, and keeps the output position in a global.
